notes: 10 real, already-published government notification PDFs. Expected values were read manually from the PDFs (2026-11-13). Qualification and pay are graded by case-insensitive substring match on the extracted text with the listed tokens (all must be present). Integer and date fields are exact matches. A field omitted from `expected` is not graded (marked '-') — used for the bilingual Hindi ad where English tokens are meaningless. Railway (all rrb*.gov.in) and state PSC (uppsc/bpsc) hosts were unreachable/scanned from the build network; UPSC (central PSC) and BHEL/IBPS stand in. Scanned controls below must be flagged is_scanned=true WITHOUT any LLM call.

pdfs.notes: 54-page CRP PO/MT-XVI notice. Registration window 01.07-21.07.2026. Annexure I total 6715 (indicative). Age band as on 01.07.2026. Document itself contains a stray internal '20.07.2027' reference (ex-servicemen clause) — do not let the LLM pick that up as last date.

Multi-post advertisement (13 total: Dental Surgeon 5, Ayurveda Physician 2, Homeopathic 1, Scientist B 5). No minimum age printed. General-category max 35 for all posts (SC Dental Surgeon is 40). Eligibility age is reckoned as on 03.07.2026 — the doc explicitly states the ORIGINAL Advertisement 06/2026 closing date 'shall prevail' for eligibility conditions, so the expected age cutoff is 2026-07-03. Application last date remains 2026-12-04.

Artisan Grade IV recruitment 2025 (Advt 04/2025). 515 posts across 11 units, trade table sums to 515. General age 27 as on 01.07.2025; OBC 30 / SC-ST 32 (relaxation +5/+3 by category, as usual). min_age absent. Closing 12.08.2025 (with a printed second line '12th September, 2025' — the doc lists both; August date is the operative closing for round 1). Pay Rs 29,500-65,000 on regularization.

Advt 01/2022 Engineer/Executive Trainee (+Addendum 01/2023 interchange). 150 posts. Advt No. 02/2026 PTMC (MBBS) Delhi/NCR, walk-in interview 22.10.2026 — no online form; walk-in date is the effective last date. Age 65 as on 01.10.2026 (relaxable to 70). Pay Rs 500/hour. min_age absent.

IVP Goindwal PTMC, 1 post, MBBS + 1 yr exp. Upper age 70 as on 01.08.2026. Last date to email/post bio-data 26.08.2026. Pay Rs 400/hour (Rs 68,400/month incl. conveyance). Header in Hindi/Punjabi but body carries English.
